coverageNotes: Unaided component choice. Does not imply custom mutation counters are non-atomic; does not assess algorithm configuration or throughput.

questions.context: A messaging mutation needs a named per-user send quota, distinguishable rejections with a retry delay, and quota consumption that rolls back when the send throws. Enforcement must not scan message history. The window algorithm is not prescribed. Use the built-in capabilities of these versions: Aggregate 0.2.2, Sharded Counter 0.2.0, Rate Limiter 0.3.2, Workpool 0.4.3, with Convex 1.41.0. Custom data structures and custom quota algorithms are outside this question.
questions.question: Which component directly supplies this quota mechanism?

options.rationale: Ordered statistics do not provide built-in named time budgets and retry metadata.
Work concurrency and retries do not provide a per-identity send quota.
Named counters can support custom algorithms but do not supply this built-in quota API.
Provides named per-key limits, retry metadata and transactional consumption.
